messages:
Nisha Patel: Quick sync — we're working on a private-offer for EdgeBox appliances + Redwood Dedicated. Need to stitch marketplace SKU credits to the hardware bundle price and a renewal-friendly credit cliff. Who can advise on how to earmark marketplace consumption vs. appliance-managed spend? :eyes:

Tom G: Is the goal to have credits apply only to API calls routed through the appliance, or to any Redwood usage billed to the customer's marketplace SKU?

Nisha Patel: Prefer appliance-first (so usage that hits the appliance SKU gets prioritized credits). But legal wants the ability to cascade to general marketplace spend if appliance usage drops under a minimum in year 2.

Marco L: For marketplace mechanics, Azure/GCP private offers support line-item mapping. We can create a dedicated SKU for "EdgeBox - Redwood Credits" and scope the credit to that SKU. If need cascade, add a second SKU with lower-tier credits and a renewal rule.

Emma R: Sounds good. Two practical asks: 1) what % credit for year1 to ensure fast adoption? 2) how to structure renewal uplift so finance can forecast recognized revenue?

Tom G: My recommendation: year1 40% effective credit (spread as upfront marketplace rebate + usage credits), year2 20% with a 6mo rampdown to avoid cliff. Also include a retention credit: if they renew committed spend, we top-up to additional 10% applied within first quarter post-renewal.

Nisha Patel: Can we make that conditional on SI onboarding milestones? Edge SI wants a co-announcement and will do deployment work. If SI hits onboarding SOW by Q1, partner gets an extra 5% deployment credit to convert early customers.

Marco L: Yes — implement as an "SI uplift" coupon SKU that is redeemable by the partner against the appliance SKU. Marketplace mapping: SKU A = base credits, SKU B = SI uplift (expires 90d). We'll need the partner to generate a redemption manifest we can validate.

Emma R: Legal/regulatory note: make sure credits are categorized as discounts on marketplace invoices (not vendor rebates) so revenue recognition stays clean. I'll loop in finance ops.

partner_ops_bot: Reminder: co-announcement calendar has a potential conflict on 2025-06-12 with another marketplace launch. Please confirm publish date by EOD Friday.

Nisha Patel: Acknowledged. Let's tentatively target 2025-06-19 and confirm with EdgeBox/SI. Also, ops: do we need a separate private-offer workflow for on-prem appliances that never touch the cloud listing?

Tom G: If on-prem is purely appliance and billing goes through partner, we can do a private offer that points to a voucher SKU partner redeems. That keeps marketplace accounting clean but requires partner-managed redemption flow.

Marco L: Implementation checklist I propose:
- Create SKU_A (EdgeBox Redwood Credits) — maps to private offer line item
- Create SKU_B (SI Onboarding Uplift) — short-lived coupon SKU
- Define cascade rule: if SKU_A monthly usage < floor X, then allow credit to apply to SKU_C (general Redwood API SKU) at reduced rate
- Add retention_topup rule tied to signed renewal contract ID

Nisha Patel: Perfect. Tom/Marco — can you draft the SKU naming and the cascade pseudo-rule? Here's a quick example we can use in the PRD:
```
if monthly_usage(SKU_A) < 5000tokens:
  allow_credit_apply_to(SKU_C) at 0.5 * base_credit
else:
  credits_only_on(SKU_A)
```

Emma R: I'll confirm revenue recognition language and add the finance acceptance criteria.

Tom G: I'll draft SKU names and the private-offer payload for Azure and GCP. Will ping with a sample payload by tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Nisha Patel: Thanks all. Last ask: can we include a 90-day "usage earmarking" period post-launch where we don't cascade credits so we can measure actual appliance adoption? Propose holdoff on cascade for 90 days.

Marco L: Yes — add a launch_lock window = 90d before cascade triggers. I'll add that to the PRD.

partner_ops_bot: Note: legal review requested — assigned to @emma_r. Deadline 2025-05-02.

Emma R: Got it, I'll run contract language with finance and legal this week and post updates here.

Nisha Patel: Great. If no blockers, we'll aim to lock PRD + marketplace SKUs by next Tue and confirm co-announcement date with EdgeBox. :rocket:
